name: Togo communes
description: One hundred seventeen official gouv.tg commune polygons. Geometry is unmodified; cross-layer topology exceptions are flagged.

properties.canonical_mapping_rationale: Only unmatched canonical commune remaining inside a verified prefecture crosswalk
Official prefecture B03 maps to Amou; 5 of 6 linked canton records point to AMOU 3. The Zio 3 link is cross-prefecture and retained in review.
B08051 is KLOTO 1 and B08053 is KLOTO 3; 3 of 4 linked canton records point to KLOTO 2. The Yokélé link is retained in review.
D05092 maps to Doufelgou 1 and spatially corrected D05094 maps to Doufelgou 2; D05093 is the remaining official commune geometry. Linked canton parents are retained in review.
Défalé and Kpaha canton geometries are fully inside D05094 although their raw FID prefixes are D05093.
